name: Dataset profile
description: Ingest a tabular file with pandas and profile every field — type, missing share, distinct count, sample values — as a table, metrics and a Parquet copy; never rows.

human_review.notes: Owner review 2026-09-21 (TBD-713): APPROVED skl_dataset_profile 1.0.2 — ingest cell skeleton, exact object→string coercion before Parquet, metrics are single numbers.

dataset.description: nexus://chat/attachment/… of the file, materialised at /nexus/in/<filename>

examples.title: xlsx with a definitions sheet
examples.expected_output:
{"code": "import nexus
import pandas as pd
path = '/nexus/in/sample.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='Sheet1', engine='openpyxl')  # the data sheet named by the source hint
defs = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name='визначення полів', engine='openpyxl')  # two columns: field, description
…
obj = df.select_dtypes(include='object').columns; df[obj] = df[obj].astype('string')
df.to_parquet('dataset.parquet', index=False); nexus.file('dataset.parquet', 'dataset.parquet')
nexus.metric('rows', len(df)); nexus.metric('columns', df.shape[1]); nexus.metric('sheets', 2)
nexus.table(defs, 'Field definitions')
nexus.table(profile, 'Dataset profile')
nexus.metric('profile.completed', 1)", "intent": "read the data sheet of the workbook, keep it as Parquet, profile every field; keep the definitions sheet as a table"}
